repair.defect: The v1 panel retained inherited official out_* aggregates as probability-consumer targets. One suspended-game cross-team player identity had four raw terminal PAs but zero inherited exposure.
repair.source_of_truth: Unique regular-season raw terminal PA events keyed by game_pk, batter, and at_bat_number
fail_closed: reject missing or duplicate terminal PA identity
reject unknown game types or terminal events
require raw class counts to sum to terminal PA count
require consumed out_* decomposition to equal raw target_* classes exactly

chronology.feature_source_rule: regular-season pitches with source_game_date strictly before target_game_date

selection_gates.materiality: candidate-minus-strongest-comparator point and date-block 95% upper bound must each be below negative 1% of comparator Brier and log loss
selection_gates.auc: candidate point estimate must be noninferior separately for Hits, HR, and Total Bases
selection_gates.promotion: fresh untouched confirmation is required after selection; 2024 cannot authorize promotion
